verdict.rationale: Treasury Prime is a banking API platform, so asking whether it can version, review, and roll back automations is a fair question. The evidence pack shows no automation versioning, review workflow, or rollback capability. Webhook create/update/delete endpoints and the sandbox are adjacent features, not version history or rollback of automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
